content: Wisdom arrives only when you stop chasing it in noisy words and seek it in sacred silence.
author: Native American Proverbs
sourceWork: Dakota & Great Plains Vision Quest Precepts
explanation: During the Hanbleceya (vision quest), the seeker does not take books, smartphones, or debate partners to the mountaintop. They sit alone on a buffalo robe in total fasting and silence for four days. When the noise of the human ego finally ceases, sacred wisdom descends.
practicalInsight: Set aside fifteen minutes of complete digital silence today. Stop hunting for answers and simply listen.
reflectionPrompt: How much of your spiritual confusion is caused by constantly consuming other people's noisy opinions?
